title: Operation and decline of the Barbegal mill complex, the largest industrial complex of antiquity
version: Geoarchaeology 39, 594–608; identified cached original PDF reopened.
lineage: Selected original article passage inspected; the local copy is hash-identified. Only p. 595 §2 inspected for this proposition. Retrospective site chronology cites Leveau 1995, Leveau et al. 2000 and Sürmelihindi et al. 2020; overlaps the 2018 research group and historical evidence, not independent corroboration.

passages.quote: the entire southern branch was detached at the site of the basin and used to feed the newly conceived Barbegal mill complex
passages.note: Specifies repurposing of a branch of the Arelate supply with a new parallel bridge; dates the transformation to the second century CE.
